QuestInfo.name: Borrowing Sera's Mirror
QuestInfo.1: You meet Heena, who is worried the sun will damage her skin. Go get a mirror from her sister, Sarah, so she can check.
QuestInfo.2: Heena asked you to get a mirror from her sister, so you walked all the way to Sarah.

0.0: You must be the new traveler. I'll be giving you important information so listen up. First, if you want to talk to anyone, #bclick#k the person with your mouse.
0.1: The #bleft and right arrows#k allow you to move. Press #bAlt#k to jump. Jump diagonally by pressing both together.
0.2: Man, it's scorching hot today! The sun is burning my beautiful skin! Can you get me a #bmirror#k from #r#p2100##k, please? I have to check my skin!
0.3: If you want to check your progress in a quest, open the #bQuest Window#k by pressing the #bQ key#k, then press #bQuest Helper#k. You'll be able to view the progress of quests registered to the Quest Helper.

yes.0: Thank you. #r#p2100##k is on the hill to the east, hanging laundry. The mirror looks like this #i4031003#.

no.0: Don't want to? Fine, come back when you change your mind.

npc.0: Haven't met with #r#p2100##k yet? She should be down a hill to the east. It shouldn't be hard to find her.
